batch.description: HSTU B Unit (shift 1) MCQ question bank, academic session 2024-2025, transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Mathematics 15 of 25, English 15 of 25; page 2 of each subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched or bypassed). All 60 publicly readable cards are included. EXTRACTION NOTE: public window = Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Mathematics 15 of 25, English 15 of 25 = 60 of the stated 100 questions; the remaining questions are behind Satt's login gate and are NOT in this pack. Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against each card's test-mode answer field; the two agreed on every card that carries a key). Content is single-source (Satt Academy) and is not cross-source verified; both verification statuses are therefore 'unverified'. Keyless cards (Satt publishes no key for them): Physics #14 (Satt qid 545315); Chemistry #8 (Satt qid 545336); Mathematics #7 (Satt qid 545360); Mathematics #9 (Satt qid 545362); English #5 (Satt qid 545377). Bengali numerals in the source were converted to Western digits and MathML formulas linearised (fractions as a/b, powers as ^) per project convention; original wording and option order preserved. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs porikha.com (Joykoly): 52 of 60 publicly available questions verified (the paper's remaining questions are login-gated on Satt and were not extracted). row 14: no key in either source - included with unknown answer row 21: excluded (DIFFER) row 23: no key in either source - included with unknown answer row 27: excluded (DIFFER) row 33: key taken from porikha (b) row 36: excluded (DIFFER) row 37: no key in either source - included with unknown answer row 39: excluded (DIFFER) row 40: excluded (DIFFER) row 46: excluded (second source highlights two options ['b', 'c'] - answer contested) row 50: excluded (second source highlights two options ['a', 'b'] - answer contested) row 58: excluded (DIFFER)

Satt's exam name on the page: HSTU B Unit (১ম শিফট), শিক্ষাবর্ষ 2024-2025, exam date 06-05-2025. Per-subject first pages retrieved the same day via the subject links on that page are stored as satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-physics.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-chemistry.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-mathematics.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-english.html under sources/. Page 2 of each subject section requires login on Satt Academy and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so only the first 15 of each subject's 25 questions are in this pack. Satt states 100 questions for this set (subject navigation: 25 per subject); the saved 'all' page's total_question attribute reads 100. No independent second source has been applied yet (independentSecondUrl empty), so content is unverified.
